availability.note: 'BYD ATTO 1 Essential' listed with a price in the configurator BYD AU's Build & Price redirects to, 2026-11-26; two grades, matching CarExpert

listPrice.note: configurator variant price 23990 (vehicle subtotal; on-road fees are added separately to reach drive-away). CarExpert (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2026-byd-atto-1-price-and-specs-australias-cheapest-ev-undercuts-many-ice-rivals) says 'before on-road costs' in words for the same figure. App VIC drive-away $25,877.58. Configurator also runs a $19,990 drive-away campaign on this grade (orders 15 Sep-15 Dec 2026, VIC private incentive $6,909.75), implying a normal VIC drive-away of ~$26,900, above the app's figure, consistent with list + on-roads + dealer delivery. Campaign ignored as temporary.

batteryKwh.note: usable; EV Database lists nominal 32.0 kWh for the European Dolphin Surf Active, the same car (ANCAP confirms identical safety spec); CarExpert AU quotes 30kWh unlabelled

rangeKm.note: BYD AU 'Driving range WLTP 220km'; matches EV Database WLTP 220 km for the EU Active on the same pack. AU grade on 15-inch steel 175/65 R15; direction test passes (equal, not higher)

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: EV Database WLTP rated consumption 155 Wh/km (grid, incl. charging losses); battery/range gives 13.6

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: BYD AU 'boot capacity of 308 litres'; method unstated; EV Database lists the same 308 L and no frunk; taken as to the cargo cover

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: BYD AU 'expand to 1,037 litres when the rear seats are folded down'

towKg.note: EV Database braked towing 0 kg; BYD AU page and AU reviews give no tow rating

warrantyYears.note: BYD AU 'Vehicle Warranty - 6 years or 150,000 kms'; traction battery 8 years/160,000km

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored below geely-ex2-complete ($26,490, $1,150) and byd-dolphin-essential ($29,990, $1,250) as the cheapest, lowest-powered BEV held; unchanged from held value.

depreciationCurve.note: BYD brand convention shared by Dolphin, Atto 2, Shark 6 and most BYD rows (one curve per brand); steeper than the mainstream default given repeated BYD drive-away campaigns, including this car's own $19,990 drive-away offer (configurator, Sep-Dec 2026). Unchanged from held value.
